document.title: Can AI Replace a Doctor? A Clinical Delegation Boundary Research Proposal

source_controls.discovery_method: OpenAlex and AnySearch Academic dual-engine search with DOI-based cross-validation where records overlap.

browser_metadata_check.verified_record: McKinney et al., International evaluation of an AI system for breast cancer screening, Nature, published 01 January 2020, volume 577, pages 89-94

source_controls.human_review_required: Review full-text applicability, intended-use labeling, local standard of care, privacy, ethics, regulation, and clinical endpoint selection before any study or deployment.

claim_boundary.supported_conclusion: AI can replace bounded clinical subtasks when a defined pathway satisfies task evidence, calibrated abstention, equity, accountable escalation, traceability, and lifecycle monitoring; general independent physician replacement is not established.
not_claimed: a clinical diagnosis or treatment recommendation
a live deployment, patient-data analysis, model training, or observed patient outcome
autonomous treatment or unrestricted clinical decision authority
